questions.question: "Bankruptcy and insolvency" is listed in the __________ list given in the Seventh Schedule in the Constitution of India.
questions.solution:
Seventh Schedule of the Indian Constitution provides for various items divided between Union, State and Concurrent list.

**Union List**: 100 items on which Parliament has exclusive power to make laws

**State List**: 61 items on which States can make and regulate laws

**Concurrent List**: 52 items on which both Central and State governments can make laws

questions.question: A peace treaty between Japan and which country has not been concluded yet, even after 70 years have passed since the end of World War Two?
questions.solution: Japan and Russia have not been able to sign a peace treaty after World War II due to the Kuril Islands dispute. Kuril Islands dispute is a disagreement between Japan, Russia and some individuals of the Ainu people over sovereignty of the South Kuril Islands.

questions.question: Nepal does not share its border with which Indian state?
questions.solution: Nepal shares its border with five Indian states. These are Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, and Sikkim. Nepal does not share its border with Haryana.

questions.question: _______ determines colour, texture, chemical properties, mineral content and permeability of soil.
questions.solution: Parent rock is the original rock out of which small rocks, soil etc are formed. It has a large influence on the colour, texture, chemical properties, mineral content and permeability of the resultant soil.

questions.question: _________ is any attribute of the organism (morphological, physiological, behavioural) that enables the organism to survive and reproduce in its habitat.
questions.solution: Adaptation refers to the process of changing oneself morphologically, physiologically and or, behaviourally so as to ensure one’s survival its habitat. Bird calls and migration are examples of adaptations.

questions.question: Captain Manoj Kumar Pandey was awarded the Param Vir Chakra for his martyrdom at which of the following wars?
questions.solution: Captain Manoj Kumar Pandey is also known as Hero of Batalik. He was posthumously awarded the Param Vir Chakra, for his courage and leadership during the Kargil War in 1999. Param Vir Chakra is the India's highest military honour.

questions.question: "Young Girls" is the famous work of which painter?
questions.solution: Young Girl is a 1932 painting by Amrita Shergil. Shergil was a Hungarian-Indian painter and has been called one of the greatest avant-garde women artists of the early 20th century. Other famous paintings by her include Hungarian Gypsy Girl, Group of three girls, Bride’s toilet and Village scene.

questions.question: In _________, the short run equilibrium results in quantity produced being lesser and prices being higher compared to perfect competition.
questions.solution:

** Description**

In monopolistic competition, the firm maximizes its profits and produces a quantity where the firm's marginal revenue (MR) is equal to its marginal cost (MC). The firm charges the price based on average revenue (AR) curve. The difference between the firm's average revenue and average cost, is the total profit earned by the firm.

questions.question: A ball rolling along the ground gradually slows down and finally comes to rest is due to ________.
questions.solution: Friction is a kind of force that resists the relative motion of a body on solid as well as liquid surface. It is always applied in the opposite direction of the motion and thus, it gradually slows down the speed of the body finally bringing it to rest.

questions.question: The angle between the __________ and the incident ray is called the angle of incidence.

questions.question: The melting point of ice is ____ K.
questions.solution: The melting point of ice is 273.156 K (where K is Kelvin) which is equal to 0oC (where C is Celsius). This is the temperature at which ice starts melting into water.

questions.question: ________ is made by mixing iron with carbon and metals like chromium, nickel and manganese.
questions.solution: Stainless Steel is a kind of alloy of Iron which has at least 10.5% Chromium. It also contains small amounts of Carbon, Silicon, Nickel and Manganese. It is called Stainless Steel as it is more resistant to corrosion as compared to normal steel.

questions.question: Animals belonging to phylum _________ are fundamentally characterised by the presence of a notochord, a dorsal hollow nerve cord and paired pharyngeal gill slits.
questions.solution: Animals belonging to phylum Chordata are called Chordate. These animals usually have a notochord, a hollow dorsal nerve cord, and a post-anal tail. Blue Whale is a Chordate.

questions.question: ________ are designed to read and interpret HTML.
questions.solution: A web browser is a software which reads and interprets HTML codes to display web pages made on the internet. It does so by reading the URL of the HTML page and decrypting it to understandable language. Chrome, Firefox are examples of browser.

questions.solution: Raziya Sultana was the daughter of Shams-ud-din Iltutmish and also the only female ever to rule the Delhi Sultanate. She belonged to Mamluk Dynasty and ruled Delhi from November 10, 1236 to October 14, 1240.

questions.question: The average product curve is inverse _______ shaped.
questions.solution: Average Product Curve shows the relation between change in average product and the quantity of the variable input. This curve also shows the per unit output at each level of the variable input. Its shape is in the form of a hump or an inverse U because of increasing marginal returns at the beginning followed by decreasing and then diminishing marginal returns.

questions.question: The _________ are the primary female sex organs that produce the female gamete (ovum) and several steroid hormones (ovarian hormones).
questions.solution: Ovaries are found in the reproductive system of females and are responsible for producing ovum which ultimately gets fertilized by the sperm inside the uterus.
